message.content:
Build NEWSLETTER CAMPAIGNS (compose + send to subscribers) for the Nxeon admin at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` → `await requireArea("platform")`. Design: `.card`,`.input`,`.btn-*`,`.table-shell`; `import { PageHeader, Badge, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`. Models: `NewsletterSubscriber{ email, source, createdAt }`, NEW `NewsletterCampaign{ id, subject, html, status("DRAFT"|"SENDING"|"SENT"|"FAILED"), sentCount, createdAt, sentAt }`. Email sending: `import { sendMail } from "@/lib/mailer"` (READ it for the exact signature — send one message per subscriber, or use its API; it logs to EmailLog automatically). Use the branded wrapper if mailer exposes one.

## TASK
Admin `/admin/newsletter` (`requireArea("platform")`): a composer (subject + HTML/markdown body with a live preview) that saves a `NewsletterCampaign` (DRAFT), a list of past campaigns with status/sentCount/date, and a **Send** button. `sendCampaign(id)`: set SENDING, load all `NewsletterSubscriber`, send each via `sendMail` (best-effort, count successes, keep going on failures, throttle a bit if trivial), set SENT + `sentCount` + `sentAt` (or FAILED). Show a subscriber count. Confirm before sending. Keep it resilient — a send failure to one address shouldn't abort the batch.

## OWNED FILES (create ONLY these)
`lib/actions-newsletter-campaign.ts` (`"use server"`: `createCampaign`, `updateCampaign`, `deleteCampaign`, `sendCampaign`), `app/admin/newsletter/page.tsx`, `components/admin/NewsletterComposer.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
Never touch schema/next.config/layouts/Shell/lib/mailer.ts(read-only import)/lib/db/rbac/auth/worker/app-other/ROADMAP/docs/sitemap or others' files. No build/prisma/generate/restart/commit. No new deps. `"use server"` = async-only.

## REPORT
Files created; how compose + send work; INTEGRATION NEEDED (admin nav link `/admin/newsletter`; `HREF_AREA` entry `"/admin/newsletter":"platform"`); risks (e.g. large lists / SMTP not configured yet).

The Prisma client already includes `NewsletterCampaign`, so no generate is needed.

## Done — Newsletter Campaigns built

### Files created (only my owned files)
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-newsletter-campaign.ts` — `"use server"`: `createCampaign`, `updateCampaign`, `deleteCampaign`, `sendCampaign`
- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/newsletter/page.tsx` — the `/admin/newsletter` page (`requireArea("platform")`)
- `/opt/nxeon/components/admin/NewsletterComposer.tsx` — client composer + `CampaignRowActions`

TypeScript checks clean for all three (the only `tsc` errors are pre-existing, in unrelated `test/*.ts` files).

### How compose works
The page shows a composer card (subject + body textarea) with a **live side-by-side preview**. The body accepts markdown (headings, bold, italic, inline code, bullet lists, links) or raw HTML — a small `bodyToHtml` renderer converts markdown, and passes raw HTML through untouched (block-tag heuristic). Saving calls `createCampaign` (or `updateCampaign` when `?edit=<id>`) via `useActionState`, storing a `NewsletterCampaign` with `status: "DRAFT"`. The raw authored body is stored in the `html` column so drafts stay editable; conversion happens at send time. Sent/sending campaigns are immutable and can't be re-edited. A subscriber count is shown in the header and the composer footer.

### How send works
`sendCampaign(id)`: sets `SENDING`, loads all `NewsletterSubscriber`, renders the body once through `bodyToHtml` then the branded `wrapEmail` shell (imported from `@/lib/mailer`), and sends one `sendMail` per subscriber. Failures are counted and skipped (each recipient wrapped in try/catch on top of `sendMail`'s own no-throw contract) so one bad address never aborts the batch; a 40 ms per-message throttle eases the SMTP relay. On finish it sets `SENT` + `sentCount` + `sentAt`, or `FAILED` if zero sent. `sendMail` auto-logs every attempt to `EmailLog`. The **Send** button lives on each campaign row and requires a `window.confirm` naming the subject and subscriber count. Delete also has an inline confirm and is refused mid-send.

### INTEGRATION NEEDED (not my files — please wire up)
1. Admin nav: add a link to `/admin/newsletter` (platform/ADMIN section) in the admin Shell/sidebar.
2. `lib/rbac.ts` `HREF_AREA`: add `"/admin/newsletter": "platform"`. (Not strictly required — `areaForHref` already defaults unknown routes to `platform` — but add it for consistency with the other entries.)

### Risks
- **Large subscriber lists**: sending runs inline in the server action with a 40 ms/message delay, so thousands of subscribers could exceed request timeouts. For scale this should move to the worker queue (batched/background) — fine for current list sizes.
- **SMTP not configured**: if no SMTP is set (and no local MTA), every `sendMail` returns false; the campaign is marked `FAILED` and the UI reports "No emails could be sent — check the SMTP configuration in Settings." No partial-silent failure.
- **No unsubscribe link**: the shared `wrapEmail` footer says "You received this because you have a Nxeon account" but there's no unsubscribe mechanism yet — worth adding for compliance, but that touches `lib/email-render`/schema (not my area).
